lines.say: Dare. Obviously dare. I don't do truth. Truth is for people with nothing to prove.
You have a lot to prove.

game.prompt: Pretend to knock on an invisible door and act out being hopelessly lost.
game.perform: Excuse me! Is this the way to... anywhere?

after.say: That's it? That's the dare? An invisible door?
Bring me a real door. Bring me the scariest door in Maple Hollow.
You said it. I just want that written down.

lines.say: A ghost band. They died mid-song. You can hear them tuning up.
I heard a cursed bake sale.
How is a bake sale cursed?
Nobody came. For a hundred years.
But what was it, before? Who built it?
Listen, dares are optional. Legally. We could go swimming instead.
I'm a lifeguard. I guard life. Yours, specifically.
Don't use the front, the back door sticks but the front's got that loose...
Busy guy. Lots of legal hearing.
Friends. If I don't come back, tell my family I won. At anything. Doesn't matter what.
This is the longest three metres of my life.
He's got a good pace. Very respectful.
Touching it. I'm touching it. It's touched.
It's not supposed to do that.
I wasn't scared. I was warming up.
The screaming. You have to warm up or you pull something.
You warmed up for a very long time.
Come on, Rocco. Let's get you home before you get scared again.
